claims.claim: SailPoint's identity-security thesis is expanding from human identities toward machine and agentic identities, creating a structurally larger control surface as enterprises deploy AI agents.

Recent reported results indicated AI-driven solutions contributed more than 30% of new ARR, an emerging signal that the AI-identity thesis is converting into bookings rather than remaining only product positioning.

factors.name: agentic identity demand
factors.basis: AI adoption increases non-human identity count and access-control complexity.

factors.name: AI product conversion
factors.basis: Reported new-ARR contribution suggests monetization of AI-driven capabilities.

risks.risk: Latest AI new-ARR mix is supported here by an independent report; a same-period primary earnings release should be acquired by the root owner before numeric underwriting.

unknowns.unknown: The newest primary-source fiscal-period detail was not located in this Scout pass; do not transpose older fiscal-2026 figures into current fiscal-2027 underwriting.

claims.claim: Independent reporting on the latest quarter described adjusted EPS of $0.09, revenue of about $308.8M, ARR of $1.231B growing 25% year over year, and raised fiscal-2027 ARR guidance to $1.375B-$1.385B.
The same report noted revenue slightly missed consensus despite stronger ARR and guidance, creating a mixed expectations signal rather than a uniformly positive print.

factors.name: ARR execution
factors.basis: ARR growth and raised guidance indicate recurring-demand resilience.

factors.name: expectation sensitivity
factors.basis: A modest revenue miss accompanied otherwise strong recurring metrics and muted share reaction.

risks.risk: Current-period numeric underwriting should wait for direct primary filing/earnings materials rather than rely solely on press interpretation.

contradictions.claim: Strong ARR/guidance versus slight revenue miss and weak market response
contradictions.resolution: Treat as mixed execution/expectations evidence; recurring demand appears strong but market expectations were already elevated.

unknowns.unknown: Exact current-period primary reconciliation and GAAP/non-GAAP bridge remain for Alpha acquisition.
